overall_goal: Wrap and store the leftover potato chicken balls and put away the cling film

goals.description: Wrap the leftover potato chicken balls with cling film
goals.rationale: The person stretches out cling film and wraps it securely around the tupperware containing the leftovers.

goals.description: Store the wrapped leftovers in the freezer
goals.rationale: The person walks to the freezer, opens the door, places the wrapped tupperware inside, and closes the door.

goals.description: Store the cling film in the cupboard
goals.rationale: The person returns to the counter, picks up the pack of cling film, opens a cupboard drawer, places the pack inside, and closes the drawer.
